full_judgment: 7. Mr Ali Imam Khaled Rahim along with Mr Md Mobarak Hossain Bhuiyan, the learned Advocate for the petitioner submit that the learned Judge of the both courts below committed error in dismissing the suit on surmise and conjecture. He submits that the defendant No. 1 executed and registered the deed of contract on receipt of Taka 1,50,000 as part consideration money which is admitted by himself and handed over the possession of the suit land to the plaintiff petitioner and the balance consideration money Taka 45,000 has been paid to the trail court as the defendant No. 1 refused to take the same but both the courts below failing to consider real facts dismissed the suit. He further submits that the courts below failed to consider the original deed which is admitted by the defendant No. 1 and committed illegality in placing reliance upon the attendance registrar which carries no presumption that the defendant No. 1 never left his office room for a single moment and his own witness as DW 3 admitted that they frequently go outside their office after signing the attendance register.
